decisions.reason: The MQTT proxy costs almost nothing to host as a download, but newer native MQTT bindings may make it redundant, so the risk of retirement is higher while keeping it remains cheap.
The CAN bus module serves industrial and automation users whose needs resolve slowly, and the holding cost in the catalog is low, so the option stays open despite limited visibility.
Demand for indoor climate and CO2 monitoring has strengthened, so the module's value is being realized and abandoning it would forfeit upside.
The touch panel accessory has uncertain demand and could suffer from component shortages, but it is cheap to carry and complements display projects, so it is kept for now.
